SOURCE-COMPUTER TI-990-10 / OBJECT-COMPUTER PCI-5H are nominal entries.

purpose.domain_detail: Italian ERP/accounting system — anagrafica (master data) search program for clients, suppliers, and chart-of-accounts (CLI/FOR/P.CONTI). Part of PRAGMA financial/accounting software suite.
purpose.summary: FINANA is a batch/interactive program that searches and manages master-data records (anagrafica) for clients, suppliers, and account codes in an Italian accounting/ERP system. It handles indexed file I/O with SQL, supports multiple search criteria (province, agent, channel, category), and maintains extensive customer/supplier fields including VAT, payment terms, bank details, and commission data.

notable_features: EXEC SQL (embedded SQL / DB2-style database access)
41 COPY statements (heavy use of copybooks for file definitions and working storage)
LOCK MODE IS MANUAL WITH ROLLBACK (Micro Focus/RM-COBOL file locking)
CRT STATUS and EVENT STATUS (screen handling)
Large record layout (~2000 bytes, APPO-AN-REC-BACKUP PIC X(2000)
Conditional compilation indicators (C94, AB, MAR10 in area A)
verdict.notes: Source is truncated to first 16000 chars of a 257KB / 5809-line file. Italian-language program from PRAGMA software house, dated April 2001. No COMP-3 usage detected despite financial domain — may use display numerics or SQL for arithmetic. Dialect is most likely Micro Focus COBOL for PC (possibly ACU); RM-COBOL also possible given LOCK MODE syntax. The SOURCE-COMPUTER TI-990-10 entry appears vestigial/nominal.
